entities.summary: José de Calasanz, or in Catalan Calassanç , born José Vives y Tutó ; his given name is written in English as Joseph Calasanz), OFMCap, was an influential Spanish Roman Catholic theologian, member of the Capuchin friars and from 19 June 1899 also cardinal. To distinguish him from the saint Giuseppe Calasanzio from whom he took his name, he is known as either José de Calasanz Vives y Tutó or Cardinal Calasanz.
